title: Report a bug
intro: Describe what is wrong: your message is emailed to the platform administrator, who can reply to you.
descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. When I tap “Declare” on the Presence screen, nothing happens.
expectedPlaceholder: e.g. The declaration window should open.
addFile: Add a screenshot or a file
filesHint: Images or PDFs, {max} files at most. You can also paste a screenshot (Ctrl+V).
sentText: Your report has been passed on to the administrator, who will reply by email if needed.

errors.type: “{name}” is not accepted: images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP) or PDF only.
errors.totalTooLarge: Files must not exceed {max} MB in total.
errors.send: The report could not be sent. Please try again later.
